author: Lost in Time
description:
Check out my online store to support the channel and find interesting products! https://lostintime.io

In this video we cover four of Nikola Tesla's most incredible inventions.  How did they work? And did they actually work? We've researched the Wardenclyffe tower, the first radio controlled boat ever demonstrated in public, the death ray, and Nikola Tesla's war with Thomas Edison.
